name: pg_with_assert_failure_recursive
subject: Fix Assert failure in WITH RECURSIVE UNION queries
goal:
A recursive CTE using UNION rather than UNION ALL can assert while removing duplicate rows from the non-recursive term when that term supplies a buffered heap tuple slot.

Create a temporary table containing duplicate integer rows and use it as the non-recursive term of `WITH RECURSIVE cte AS (SELECT ... UNION SELECT ... FROM cte)`. The query must terminate and return the single distinct value, without assertion or memory error. UNION ALL recursion and duplicate elimination for other input slot types must remain unchanged.
